note: CAPTURE-FRAMING PIN. cellW/cellH are the LIVE Figma VARIANT-cell dimensions, minted from the Desktop Bridge (figma-console figma_execute, fileKey pinned) — NOT derived from the committed PNGs. scripts/console-loop-capture-framing-check.mjs asserts that every committed canvas shot is that cell plus ONE uniform margin, and that the reference the scorer resolves is comparable, in-library, provenance-resolvable and not flush against its harness stage edge.

mintedFrom.method: COMPONENT_SET children walk; cell dimensions read from node.width/node.height; ambiguous cells disambiguated by the cell's own solid fill against the committed shot's dominant colour (see stems[].cellNote)

guard.framingCausesNote: C2 (reference comparability) is waived on a fail-closed receipt by naming ANY of these in visual.defects. A stem already retargeted to a correct like-for-like reference that still sits outside the guard names the real emit defect (FC-ABS-SIZE / FC-WIDTH-TOKEN), not the generic framing code.

accordion.cellNote: Align=End and Align=Start are both 328x98, so C1 cannot discriminate them; this pin records the cell whose variant the receipt's reference names (end.lg).

checkbox.cellNote: All three Checked cells are 136x20; the committed shot depicts an empty box, so Unchecked.

icon-button.cellNote: Disambiguated by fill: the shot's dominant colour is #0f62fe, the Primary btn fill (Secondary #393939, Tertiary/Ghost #000000).

inline-notification.cellNote: All twelve cells are 346x48; this pin records the cell whose variant the receipt's reference names (error.high).

tabs.cellNote: All three State cells are 328x40; recorded as the Default state the receipt's reference names.

tag.cellNote: Disambiguated by fill: the shot's pill fill is #d0e2ff, the Blue tag background.

toggle.cellNote: Untoggled cells are 75x58 and Toggled cells 74x58, so the 76x58 committed shot resolves to Untoggled.
